page.content:
Battleship roll — nori wall holding a loose topping on rice.

How Gunkan-maki connects

  • Item: Maki — Gunkan-maki is a nori-walled variant of the roll.
  • Item: Nori — A nori strip is the 'hull' of gunkan-maki.

What is Gunkan-maki?

Gunkan-maki wraps a strip of nori around shari so uni, ikura, or tartare will sit still, a Meiji-era addition to the nigiri counter.

Key threads lead to Maki and Nori.
